title: Local Government Directory districts (2024), republished by bharatlas
credit: Local Government Directory, Government of India; bharatlas / urbanmorph
note: A dated 2024 boundary snapshot, not a claim to reflect subsequent district reorganisations. Two source features (Mirpur and Muzaffarabad) have no LGD code and retain name-based identities.
processing: District polygons clipped to existing state land masks and cleaned together; smaller source districts take precedence over overlapping older district polygons. State, context and international assets are unchanged.
